note: Victoria II's earliest bookmark is 1836. Grand Century starts on 1830-01-01, so these deltas roll the Vic2 baseline back six years. Each entry names the Vic2 region, the owner Vic2 ships, and the owner that region actually had on 1830-01-01. A few entries are not rollbacks but corrections: Vic2 flattens some autonomous polities into their overlord outright, and the why field says so. Tags are Vic2 tags; the map build maps them to Grand Century tags afterwards.

ownership.why: The French invasion of Algiers landed in June 1830 and the city fell on 5 July. On 1 January 1830 the Regency of Algiers was still whole under Ottoman suzerainty.
The Belgian Revolution began in August 1830 and independence was recognised in 1839. On 1 January 1830 Flanders was part of the United Kingdom of the Netherlands.
As Vlaanderen: still Dutch on 1 January 1830.
The Republic of Texas declared independence in March 1836. In 1830 Texas was Mexican, under the colonisation restrictions of the Law of 6 April 1830.
Gran Colombia broke up over 1830-31; Ecuador seceded in May 1830. On 1 January 1830 the union was still formally intact.
Ecuadorian Amazonia, part of Gran Colombia at the start of 1830.
Venezuela's separation was declared through 1830 and completed in 1831; still Gran Colombian on 1 January 1830.
Muhammad Ali's invasion of Ottoman Syria ran 1831-33. In 1830 Aleppo was still governed from Constantinople.
As Aleppo: Egyptian rule in Syria begins with the 1831 campaign.
As Aleppo. Acre fell to Ibrahim Pasha in May 1832.

Congress Poland kept its own sejm, army and constitution until the November Uprising of 1830 was crushed in 1831 and the Organic Statute abolished them. On 1 January 1830 it was a Russian constituent kingdom, not a Russian province.
As Mazowieckie: within Congress Poland at the start of 1830.

The Grand Duchy of Finland has been a separate polity under the Tsar since 1809, with its own Senate, currency, laws and customs frontier. Victoria II does not model it and ships the region as plain Russian territory; on 1 January 1830 it was Russian only in the person of the sovereign.
As Southern Finland: Grand Duchy territory, administered from Helsinki rather than St Petersburg. Karelia (RUS_339) is deliberately left Russian, being Olonets and Kola rather than Finnish Karelia.
